highlights: Both require a non‑smoking household and have identical sleep windows (10 pm–6 am)
Both agree on a 4/5 cleanliness level with a rotating chore chart
Budget ranges overlap (Ananya $1000‑1400, Meera $1300‑1650) and both prefer private rooms in the same Boston neighborhoods
concerns: Both are night‑owl by nature but have negotiated flexible exam‑week sleep shifts, which could cause occasional friction
Guest policy allows up to 2 guests with 24‑hour notice; a third guest is a conditional exception that may need future clarification
Both drink socially vs. never; occasional social drinking could affect quiet hours
middle_ground: Allow a one‑time third guest with 24‑hour notice and departure by 10 pm

value.recommendation_summary: The two roommates match on all core non‑negotiables—non‑smoking, sleep schedule, cleanliness, and budget—making them a strong fit. Minor flexible points (guest limits and occasional later sleep) are already negotiated, so they can move forward confidently.
